# Test: apx optable render writes the operation tables and the route table
# (native Go, no external tools; the AppContract inputs are plain YAML files)

# One API, the spec given with --spec; the audience defaults to internal
exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stdout 'openapi/reports/server/v1 v1.0.0 \(internal\): 4 operations: read=1 list=1 write=1 custom=1 -> optable-9e288350b7'
stdout 'route reports/reports: 4 operations, default API openapi/reports/server/v1'
stdout 'wrote 1 file\(s\) to out: optable-9e288350b7.yaml'
grep '^kind: ConfigMap$' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '^  name: optable-9e288350b7$' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '^    apx.infoblox.com/operation-table: "true"$' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '^    apx.infoblox.com/api: openapi/reports/server/v1$' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '^    apx.infoblox.com/api-version: v1.0.0$' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '^  operations.json: \|$' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '"schema": "apx.infoblox.com/operation-table/v1"' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '"audience": "internal"' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '"path": "/api/v1/dashboards/\{id\}"' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '"operationId": "getDashboard"' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '"streaming": true' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
! grep 'namespace:' out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
! exists out/route-table.json

# A second render gives the same bytes
exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out again
cmp again/optable-9e288350b7.yaml out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml

# --route-table, --route-table-configmap, --namespace and the JSON summary
exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --audience openapi/reports/server/v1=public --out rt --route-table --route-table-configmap route-table --namespace traefik --format json
stdout '"api": "openapi/reports/server/v1"'
stdout '"audience": "public"'
stdout '"configMap": "optable-9e288350b7"'
stdout '"operations": 4'
stdout '"list": 1'
stdout '"defaultApi": "openapi/reports/server/v1"'
stdout '"conflicts": \[\]'
stdout '"route-table-configmap.yaml"'
grep '"schema": "traefik.infoblox.com/route-table/v1"' rt/route-table.json
grep '"namespace": "reports"' rt/route-table.json
grep '"name": "reports"' rt/route-table.json
grep '"operation": "watchEvents"' rt/route-table.json
grep 'namespace: traefik' rt/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep '"audience": "public"' rt/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
grep 'name: route-table' rt/route-table-configmap.yaml
grep 'route-table.json.gz: H4sI' rt/route-table-configmap.yaml

# The global --json flag gives the same format
exec apx --json optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stdout '"files": \['

# externalPrefix replaces the base path of the contract
exec apx optable render --binding prefix.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out prefixed
grep '"path": "/edge/v1/dashboards/\{id\}"' prefixed/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
! grep '"/api/v1/' prefixed/optable-9e288350b7.yaml

# --specs-dir: the layout of an API repository, with the audience from its catalog
exec apx optable render --binding identity.yaml --specs-dir apis --out identity --route-table
stdout 'openapi/iam/identity-internal/v2 v2.3.0 \(internal\): 3 operations'
stdout 'openapi/iam/identity/v2 v2.1.0 \(public\): 2 operations'
stdout 'route identity/identity-api: 3 operations, default API openapi/iam/identity/v2'
grep '"defaultApi": "openapi/iam/identity/v2"' identity/route-table.json
grep '"path": "/v2/accounts/\{id\}"' identity/route-table.json
! grep 'account_id' identity/route-table.json
grep '"operation": "AccountGroups_List"' identity/route-table.json

# Two APIs with the same audience on one path are a conflict; no file is written
! exec apx optable render --binding identity.yaml --specs-dir apis --audience openapi/iam/identity/v2=internal --out conflict
stderr 'route identity/identity-api: GET /v2/accounts: API openapi/iam/identity-internal/v2 and API openapi/iam/identity/v2 are in conflict: the two APIs have the same audience \(internal\)'
! exists conflict

# The JSON summary lists the conflicts
! exec apx optable render --binding identity.yaml --specs-dir apis --audience openapi/iam/identity/v2=internal --out conflict --format json
stdout '"reason": "the two APIs have the same audience \(internal\)"'
stdout '"otherApi": "openapi/iam/identity/v2"'

# A different operationId on one path is a conflict
! exec apx optable render --binding identity.yaml --spec openapi/iam/identity/v2=renamed.yaml --specs-dir apis --out conflict
stderr 'GET /v2/accounts: API openapi/iam/identity-internal/v2 and API openapi/iam/identity/v2 are in conflict: the operationId values are different \(Accounts_List and listAccounts\)'

# Binding validation
! exec apx optable render --binding bad-namespace.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'spec\.provides\.apis\[0\]\.routes\.targetRefs\[0\]: a namespace field is not permitted'
! exec apx optable render --binding bad-kind.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'no AppContract with a routes object found \(kinds in the input: RouteBinding\)'
! exec apx optable render --binding bad-version.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'unsupported apiVersion "appkit.infoblox.dev/v1" \(expected appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1 or appkit.platform.infoblox.com/v1alpha1\)'
! exec apx optable render --binding bad-group.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'AppContract "reports": unsupported apiVersion "traefik.infoblox.com/v1alpha1"'
! exec apx optable render --binding bad-target.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'kind "HTTPRoute" is not supported \(expected Ingress\)'
! exec apx optable render --binding no-pin.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'AppContract "reports": spec\.provides\.apis\[0\]: ref "apx://openapi/reports/server/v1": routes needs a pinned ref'
! exec apx optable render --binding no-scheme.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'routes needs a ref with the apx:// scheme'
! exec apx optable render --binding unknown-field.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'spec\.provides\.apis\[0\]\.routes: unknown field "timeout"'

# A RouteAPIBinding document is an error; the routes object replaces that kind
! exec apx optable render --binding old-kind.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'RouteAPIBinding is replaced by the routes object of an AppContract \(spec\.provides\.apis\[\]\.routes\)'
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --binding old-kind.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'RouteAPIBinding is replaced by the routes object of an AppContract'

# An AppContract where no entry has routes gives no binding
! exec apx optable render --binding no-routes.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'no AppContract with a routes object found \(kinds in the input: AppContract\)'

# The second API group is accepted. Fields outside routes are not checked, and
# profile, operationProfiles and tableRef are read and ignored: same bytes
exec apx optable render --binding extra-fields.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out extra
cmp extra/optable-9e288350b7.yaml out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
exec apx optable render --binding second-group.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out second
cmp second/optable-9e288350b7.yaml out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml

# Audience precedence: --audience, then routes.audience, then the catalog
exec apx optable render --binding public.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out aud1
stdout 'openapi/reports/server/v1 v1.0.0 \(public\)'
exec apx optable render --binding public.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --audience openapi/reports/server/v1=internal --out aud2
stdout 'openapi/reports/server/v1 v1.0.0 \(internal\)'
cmp aud2/optable-9e288350b7.yaml out/optable-9e288350b7.yaml
# routes.audience wins over the catalog: the catalog says public, so the two
# APIs get the same audience and are in conflict
! exec apx optable render --binding identity-routes-audience.yaml --specs-dir apis --out conflict
stderr 'the two APIs have the same audience \(internal\)'
# --audience wins over routes.audience
exec apx optable render --binding identity-routes-audience.yaml --specs-dir apis --audience openapi/iam/identity/v2=public --out aud3
stdout 'openapi/iam/identity/v2 v2.1.0 \(public\): 2 operations'
# Two routes.audience values for one API are an error, also in two inputs
! exec apx optable render --binding public.yaml --binding public-again.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'AppContract "reports-edge": spec\.provides\.apis\[0\]\.routes\.audience: API openapi/reports/server/v1 has two audiences \(public and internal\)'

# An AppContract without a namespace needs --namespace for the route table
! exec apx optable render --binding no-namespace.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out nons --route-table
stderr 'route reports has no namespace'
exec apx optable render --binding no-namespace.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out nons --route-table --namespace reports
grep '"namespace": "reports"' nons/route-table.json

# Flag errors
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --out out
stderr 'API openapi/reports/server/v1: no API contract: pass --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=<file> or --specs-dir <dir>'
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec reports.yaml --out out
stderr 'invalid --spec "reports.yaml"'
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --audience openapi/reports/server/v1=partner --out out
stderr 'invalid --audience'
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out --format xml
stderr 'invalid --format'
! exec apx optable render --binding missing.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=reports.yaml --out out
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec openapi/reports/server/v1=no-id.yaml --out out
stderr 'API openapi/reports/server/v1: POST /things has no operationId'

-- binding.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: reports
  namespace: reports
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: reports
        routes:
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports}
-- prefix.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: reports
  namespace: reports
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: reports
        routes:
          externalPrefix: /edge/v1/
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports}
-- no-namespace.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: reports
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0

          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports}
-- bad-namespace.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: reports
  namespace: reports
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: reports
        routes:
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports, namespace: other}
-- bad-kind.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: RouteBinding
metadata:
  name: reports
-- bad-version.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: reports
  namespace: reports
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: reports

          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports}
-- bad-group.yaml --

-- bad-target.yaml --

  provides:

      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: reports
        routes:
          targetRefs:
            - {group: gateway.networking.k8s.io, kind: HTTPRoute, name: reports}
-- old-kind.yaml --
apiVersion: traefik.infoblox.com/v1alpha1

  name: reports
  namespace: reports

  apis:
    - ref: openapi/reports/server/v1
      version: v1.0.0
      targetRefs:
        - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports}

-- extra-fields.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: reports
  namespace: reports
spec:
  owner: reports-team
  requires:
    databases:
      - name: reports-db
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: reports
        port: 8080
        routes:
          profile: default
          operationProfiles: {watchEvents: slow}
          tableRef: {name: optable-9e288350b7}
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports}
status:
  phase: Ready

-- second-group.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.platform.infoblox.com/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: reports
  namespace: reports
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: reports
        ref: apx://openapi/reports/server/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: reports
        routes:
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: reports}
-- reports.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Reports
  version: "1"
servers:
  - url: https://reports.example.com/api/v1
paths:
  /dashboards:
    get:
      operationId: listDashboards
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
    post:
      operationId: createDashboard
      responses:
        '201': {description: created}
  /dashboards/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getDashboard
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
  /events:
    get:
      operationId: watchEvents
      x-operation-class: custom
      responses:
        '200':
          description: a stream
          content:
            text/event-stream: {}
-- no-id.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Things
  version: "1"
paths:
  /things:
    post:
      responses:
        '201': {description: created}
-- renamed.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Identity
  version: "2"
servers:
  - url: /v2
paths:
  /accounts:
    get:
      operationId: listAccounts
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
-- apis/catalog/catalog.yaml --
version: 1
org: example
repo: apis
modules:
  - id: openapi/iam/identity/v2
    format: openapi
    path: openapi/iam/identity/v2
    audience: public
  - id: openapi/iam/identity-internal/v2
    format: openapi
    path: openapi/iam/identity-internal/v2
    audience: internal
-- apis/openapi/iam/identity/v2/identity.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Identity
  version: "2"
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/v2
paths:
  /accounts:
    get:
      operationId: Accounts_List
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
  /accounts/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: Accounts_Read
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
-- apis/openapi/iam/identity/v2/README.yaml --
note: a YAML file that is not an OpenAPI document
-- apis/openapi/iam/identity-internal/v2/identity-internal.json --
{
  "swagger": "2.0",
  "info": {"title": "Identity internal", "version": "2"},
  "basePath": "/v2",
  "paths": {
    "/accounts": {
      "get": {"operationId": "Accounts_List", "responses": {"200": {"description": "ok"}}}
    },
    "/accounts/{account_id}": {
      "get": {"operationId": "Accounts_Read", "responses": {"200": {"description": "ok"}}}
    },
    "/accounts/groups": {
      "get": {"operationId": "AccountGroups_List", "responses": {"200": {"description": "ok"}}}
    }
  }
}
